messages.subject: For Marc Benioff | AI, global affairs and responsible technology
messages.body:
Dear Salesforce Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Marc Benioff, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Salesforce's leadership in AI and digital transformation increasingly operates at the intersection of governments, public policy, trust and responsible technology. That stakeholder environment aligns closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and translate external expectations into accountable cross-functional action.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global affairs and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support Salesforce's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Salesforce.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
